name: Gibo Inkan ~Genkou no ushiro no Real~
original_name: 義母隠感 ～原稿の後ろのリアル～
source:
Makio is a “stay-at-home husband” living at his wife's parents' house. His wife, Hikaru, is a popular erotic manga artist who has been completely absorbed in her work lately.

The couple has been growing apart, and Makio hasn't been intimate with Hikaru for months. His mother-in-law, Ryouko, senses this.

Behind Hikaru's back, Ryouko and Makio begin a relationship, and little by little, their daily lives begin to change.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt307/apt307.html#link_story]official site[/url]]
translation:
Makio是一位住在妻子父母家里的“全职丈夫”。他的妻子光是一位受欢迎的色情漫画艺术家，最近她完全沉浸在她的工作中。

夫妻俩的关系越来越疏远，槙尾已经几个月没有和光亲密了。他的岳母Ryouko意识到了这一点。

凉子和真希夫背着光开始了恋爱关系，他们的日常生活逐渐开始发生变化。
